name: Q01

theorem Q01 : ∀ (a b c x : Int), 0 < a → b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c := by
  intro a b c x ha hb
  have e : 4*a*(a*x^2+b*x+c) = (2*a*x+b)^2 + (4*a*c - b^2) := by grind
  have h : 0 ≤ 4*a*(a*x^2+b*x+c) := by
    rw [e]
    exact Int.add_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.sub_nonneg.mpr hb)
  exact Int.nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h (by omega)
statement: ∀ (a b c x : Int), 0 < a → b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c

author: private-a2
name: T05
source:
theorem T05 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M h1 hM hN hS hD
  have e : Scope.Model.modeDet m N M = m.detJ * (M * M) + N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N - m.S * M) := by
    unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.detJ Scope.Model.S
    grind
  rw [e]
  have p1 : 0 < m.detJ * (M * M) := Int.mul_pos h1 (Int.mul_pos hM hM)
  have p2 : 0 ≤ N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N - m.S * M) := Int.mul_nonneg hN (Int.sub_nonneg.mpr hS)
  exact Int.add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg p1 p2
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M

author: private-a2
name: T07
source:
theorem T07 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) := by
  intro m p s h1 hp hD hS n hn
  unfold Scope.modeN Scope.modeM
  have sq : ∀ x : Int, 0 ≤ x ^ 2 := fun x => by
    have := Int.sq_nonneg x
    first | exact this | simpa [Int.pow_succ] using this
  have hM : 0 < p ^ 2 := by
    have := Int.mul_pos hp hp
    simpa [Int.pow_succ] using this
  have hN : 0 ≤ (n : Int) ^ 2 * s ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg (sq _) (sq _)
  have hn1 : (1 : Int) ≤ (n : Int) := by omega
  have hn2 : (1 : Int) ≤ (n : Int) ^ 2 := by
    have := Int.mul_le_mul hn1 hn1 (by omega) (by omega)
    simpa [Int.pow_succ] using this
  have hP : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg hD (sq s)
  have h3 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn2 hP
  have h3' : m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 ≤ (n : Int) ^ 2 * (m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2) := by
    have h := h3
    rw [Int.one_mul] at h
    exact h
  have e : m.Du * m.Dv * ((n : Int) ^ 2 * s ^ 2) = (n : Int) ^ 2 * (m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2) := by
    grind
  have hS2 : m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * ((n : Int) ^ 2 * s ^ 2) := by
    rw [e]
    exact Int.le_trans hS h3'
  exact Int.le_of_lt (T05 m _ _ h1 hM hN hS2 hD)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)

theorem D02 : ∀ (V C : Int), 0 < Scope.hdHH V C - Scope.hdDH V C ↔ C < V := by
  intro V C
  unfold Scope.hdHH Scope.hdDH
  omega
statement: ∀ (V C : Int), 0 < Scope.hdHH V C - Scope.hdDH V C ↔ C < V

author: private-a2
name: T11
source:
theorem T11 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2 := by
  intro m p s h1 h2 h3 ⟨n, hn, hneg⟩
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h4 := Int.not_lt.mp h
  exact absurd (T07 m p s h1 h2 h3 h4 n hn) (Int.not_le.mpr hneg)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2

name: T12
source:
theorem T12 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M) := by
  intro m N M htr hdet hDu hDv hM hN hS
  constructor
  · have h1 : m.trJ * M < 0 := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos htr hM
    have h2 : 0 ≤ N * (m.Du + m.Dv) := Int.mul_nonneg hN (by omega)
    unfold Scope.Model.trJ at h1
    unfold Scope.Model.modeTr
    grind
  · exact T05 m N M hdet hM hN hS (Int.mul_nonneg (Int.le_of_lt hDu) (Int.le_of_lt hDv))
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M)
